title: Cancel order
text: When: Cancellation is allowed until the order ships. How: The customer contacts support and provides their order number. After shipping: The customer can no longer cancel and should contact support about a return.

title: Changing an order
text: When: Changing an order is allowed until the order ships. This includes replacing an item with another item. How: The customer contacts support and provides their order number, what they want to change. After shipping: The customer can no longer change the order and should contact support about a return, and reorder the right articles.

title: Changing a shipping address
text: When: Changing a shipping adress is allowed until the order ships. How: The customer contacts support provides their order number, and they provide the new address. After shipping: Contact support for help.

title: Tracking an order
text: When: Tracking an order is possible when the order gets sent. How: The customer contacts support and provides their order number.

title: Contact a human agent
text: When: Customers can contact a human agent for help with an order or a shop policy. How: The customer contacts support and describes the issue. For an order question, they provide their order number.

title: Request a refund
text: When: A customer can request a refund after returning an eligible item. How: The customer contacts support and provides their order number and the reason for the refund request. After the request: Support reviews the request and tells the customer whether it is approved.

title: Return an item
text: When: A customer can request a return within 30 days of receiving an item. How: The customer contacts support with their order number and the reason for the return. Support provides return instructions. Condition: The item must be unused and in its original packaging.

title: Refund processing
text: When: An approved refund is processed after the returned item is received and inspected. How: The refund is sent to the original payment method. Timing: The shop processes approved refunds within five business days after inspection.
